# Constellation

Matrix client built with [libcosmic] and [matrix-rust-sdk](https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-sdk).

## Project Status

Alpha quality software. Usable but you should expect bugs, missing features, and potential breaking changes.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> This project is 99% AI generated. My attempt was 100% but sometimes its hard to resist that urge. Just a disclaimer.

The goal is to reach a stable 1.0 release around the same time the underlying libraries reach their stable releases.

![Screenshot of the application][image]

### Recommendations

If you are looking for a more mature Matrix client:

- **[Fractal]**: A great GTK-based cli
ent for the GNOME desktop.
- **[iamb]**: A powerful terminal-based Matrix client for Vim lovers.
